component.name: manaDJ
component.description: Scoped source inventory, not a built artifact or release clearance. Universal frozen Python release export excluding dev/harness, frontend runtime lock tree, Electron lock version and selected Android vendored DSP/font/Oboe. Platform variants are alternatives, not necessarily installed together. Native wheel payloads, ffmpeg, Python runtime, Chromium, model weights, full Android/iOS dependency trees and other assets remain incomplete or unaudited. MIT applies only to manaDJ code the licensor has the right to license; third-party rights remain separate.
